snippet.title: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road - LAUNCH TRAILER (iOS, Android, & STEAM!)
snippet.description:
It's finally out!! Go fight off some FRUITS in this action packed, Side- Scrolling Shooter game! We spent a long time making this game, PLEASE Like, Comment, and SHARE the game around!❤️

🍎 PLAY CARAVAN CARNAGE: FRUITY ROAD!

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330940/Caravan_Carnage_Fruity_Road/

ANDROID: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gonzossm.ccfr&hl=en_US

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/caravan-carnage-fruity-road/id1669059603

__________________
CREDITS FOR GAME:

Directed, Produced, Art & Animation by GonzoSSM

Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road was Programmed by Pavel Zuk

Music by StoneMcKnuckle

Background Art Assistance Quito

Voice Cast: 
Freddie Heinz (Clutch +)
Valentine Stokes (Mr. Princess +)
MeisHeaven (Junior +)
Stephanos Rex (Fruits +)
Ryitus (Grape Soda Man +)
aHobo (Squidson +)
Groxxy (Rocco +)

They all did a variety of different characters aswell!

#CaravanCarnage #Gonzossm #indiegame
